body.x: Hanshin IT(CEO Chae Jeong-Sik, www.icreon.kr) showed off a variety of video send-receive sets at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

'HS5790D3' features wireless connectivity that allows audio or video transported from Laptop or PC to any HDTV or Projector on real time. This device is rather for official meeting or lectures in B2B market since it is based on UWB technology that does not include any interference between other wireless devices and other frequency.

Except this product, Hanshin has caught attention from lots of attendees and buyers by displaying USB 3.0 Dual Video Docking Station 'HSD390DS', Video adapter 'HSD390DH', Graphic Display Adapter 'HSD350DV/HSD350HD'.

The product expands the monitor up to 6 according to customers' need who desire to expand their video or USB devices as laptops have been widely expanded. It also can expand lots of different USB devices.

Hanshin IT has made 'ICREON' which implements wireless technologies to multimedia solutions that will integrate multimedia on UWB technology. It supplies its products domestically and internationally.
'Miracast WiFi Display Adapter' is based on Miracast which is recently settled in as a smartphone video transportation standard. It performs the best capabilities by applying DualBand RF.

Hanshin exports to USA, Japan, Taiwan, Turkey and mores in an ODM format, which tends to consistently increase. It develops the products applicable to varied areas with consistent R&D support and with several certifications.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
